This indicates that a substantial portion of Asian Americans have moderate to high incomes. But in contrast the bottom 40% of Asian-Americans' income only represents 13% of the group income, with an average income of $23,744 in the lowest SES strata (AAPI Data, 2015 & Center for Household Financial Stability, 2015).
